summary: Supreme Commander entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Supreme Commander
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC Gold Edition or patched PC base game

primary.version: Supreme Commander Gold Edition / patched PC build
primary.why: Supreme Commander is a PC-first large-scale RTS, and the PC version offers the best fidelity, controls, resolution, replay, and mod/community-patch options. Gold Edition is the cleanest ownership route because it bundles the base game with Forged Alliance, but the base campaign should be logged separately if the expansion is also played.
primary.how_to_play: Use the PC Gold Edition or a patched owned PC copy. Record storefront/build, patch state, resolution/UI scaling, campaign/skirmish focus, multiplayer service or community-client use, and whether Forged Alliance content was included.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only if documenting the console conversion.
secondary.why: The PC version is the intended high-fidelity RTS route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record patch/community-client state and whether Forged Alliance content was included.
